sections.title: Emergency Notice
lines: If this is a medical emergency, hang up and dial 911 or go to the nearest emergency room immediately.

sections.title: Urgency Screening
lines: Ask whether the patient has new flashes or floaters.
Ask how long the symptom has been present.
Ask whether there is sudden or gradual vision loss.
New flashes or floaters should be treated as urgent and offered the next available appointment.

sections.title: Location and Contact
lines: Practice name: Abita Eye Group.
Address: 10495 SpringHill Drive, Springhill, FL 34608.
Email: newpatient@abitaeye.com.

sections.title: Hours
lines: Hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM.
The office is closed Saturday and Sunday.

sections.title: Other Location
lines: The other location is Eye Radiance in Crystal River at 1100 N Lyle Avenue, Crystal River, FL 34429.
Crystal River sees Dr. Licht Tuesday through Thursday from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM.

sections.title: Practice Scope
lines: This is an ophthalmology practice, not optometry.

Spring Hill sees medical and surgical eye conditions including cataract evaluation, glaucoma evaluation, retina care, uveitis care, pediatric ophthalmology, adult strabismus, double vision evaluation, and oculoplastic eyelid procedures.

sections.title: Pediatric and Strabismus Visits
lines: Spring Hill does see pediatric ophthalmology.
Dr. Bach handles pediatrics, adult strabismus, and double vision.
Dr. Bach has a limited Spring Hill schedule and may book several weeks out.

sections.title: Cataract Evaluations
lines: Spring Hill sees cataract evaluations and cataract-related surgical visits.

sections.title: Routine Eye Exams and Glasses Prescriptions
lines: The office does not perform routine eye exams or vision-only checkups.
If a caller wants a routine eye exam or a glasses prescription, let them know they would want an optometrist.

sections.title: Retina, Glaucoma, and Uveitis Care
lines: Spring Hill sees glaucoma evaluation, retina care, and uveitis care.

sections.title: Eyelid Procedures
lines: Spring Hill sees oculoplastic eyelid procedures.

sections.title: Providers
lines: Dr. Bach (NPI 16-59706588) handles pediatrics, adult strabismus, and double vision. He has a limited Spring Hill schedule and may book several weeks out.
Dr. Noel (NPI 16-59998482) handles comprehensive ophthalmology, retina, uveitis, and glaucoma.
Dr. Licht (NPI 14-97147680) handles comprehensive ophthalmology, oculoplastic eyelid surgery, and glaucoma.
If speech recognition produces Lee, Licked, Lit, Lisht, Lich, Lish, or Liked, treat that as Dr. Licht.

sections.title: Glasses Warranty
lines: Patients should bring their glasses into the Spring Hill location.
Staff will review the glasses in person and determine the available options.

sections.title: What to Bring
lines: Patients should bring a photo ID, insurance card, list of current medications, and previous eye records if available.

sections.title: Appointment Expectations
lines: New patient visits may take 1 to 2 hours.
Eye dilation may occur and can temporarily cause blurry vision and light sensitivity.
The practice typically sends an email confirmation after scheduling.
